You need real-time interaction. Multiplayer games and collaborative tools can't make a fresh request for every state change — the latency and overhead would be prohibitive. The state is large and changes frequently. Holding game world state in memory and broadcasting deltas is far more efficient than re-fetching the entire state on every interaction.
